title: Vague bi xaajale deret ji
intro: Xalaatal benn mbënd bu rëy buy yéeg ci kaw suuf si, Ark buy féey bu baax, ak benn ruuh bu bàyyi ci biti ndax tànneef. Deret ji mu àndaloon ak yonent, waaye ngëm moo ko tàqale, mu jànkoonte ak woote bu mujj ngir mu dugg ci gaal gi, bi ndox mi di gëna yokk. Ndax mën nga wax lu waral ñu bañ ko?
clues: Man doomu kenn laa ci yonent Yàlla yi gën a mag, njabootu ngëm laa tànn bàyyi.
Maa ngi dundu ci jamonoy Mbënd mu Mag mi, bi ñàkka gëm muur réew mi ni ndox.
Bi sama pàppa wooma, ma baña dugg ci gaal gi ak gëm-gëm yi.
Ma ni damay wut barabu tundu ngir musal ma ci ndox mi.
Waxoon nañu ma ne dara mënu ma aar ci dogalub Yàlla ci bis boobu lu dul yërmëndé.
Vague yi daal di jàpp ma, ma féey, ba noppi ñu wax sama pàppa ni bokkuma ci njabootam gu jub gi.

arabic: وَنَادَىٰ نُوحٌۭ رَّبَّهُۥ فَقَالَ رَبِّ إِنَّ ٱبْنِى مِنْ أَهْلِى وَإِنَّ وَعْدَكَ ٱلْحَقُّ وَأَنتَ أَحْكَمُ ٱلْحَـٰكِمِينَ
verse: And Noah called to his Lord and said, "My Lord, indeed my son is of my family; and indeed, Your promise is true; and You are the most just of judges!" (11:45)
